comments.author: Frank
comments.body: How to get this discovery? Map or Quest?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Ooo. Pretty. It's from a map that comes from St. Petersburg's archives, Appraisal section.

Name: "Caribbean ore map" (translated from Japanese via Google; actual GAMA name may differ slightly)
Description: "A map of ore stored in Port Royal's mansion" (same as above)
Skill requirements: Appraisal/Search/Unlock R8 (Search and Unlock can be up to two levels below the listed number, but Appraisal must match or exceed to get the map, and to find the discovery with it)

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/QuestDB/action/QuestShow?id=3639

comments.author: Frank
comments.body: Great, i got the map. Was the one of two treasure discos i was missing. Many thanks mate!
